# Signal Desk

Weekday compiled brief of shipped models, papers, and repos. Skills, gates, and local/sovereign runtime — not another chatbot.

## For agents

- Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roblambert9/signal-desk/main/agents/catalog.json
- Skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roblambert9/signal-desk/main/SKILL.md
- Latest issue (teaser / license required for production): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roblambert9/signal-desk/main/issues/latest.json
- Foundry: comment a repo URL on https://github.com/roblambert9/signal-desk/issues/1
- Private Foundry: Linear issue titled `Foundry: {repo}` on team Nanoempireai, label foundry
- Proofs: Shopify Theme Check, Salesforce LWC ESLint, jsx-a11y

## Prices we can fulfill

- Agent license $49/mo — commercial use of the compiled feed
- Foundry public $49 / private $199
- Issue PDF $19
- Indie brief $29/mo when Schema is green

Teaser is free. Production use by an agent is not. We do not staff SkillOps.
